messages.content: 今天美國的黃金價格是多少？

function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Face_Value.description: The face value of the bond. This is a float type value.

Coupon_rate.description: The coupon rate of the bond. This is a float type value.

Required_return.description: The required rate of return on the bond. This is a float type value.

maturity_years.description: The number of years to maturity of the bond.

message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。一般來說，黃金價格會在每個交易日的不同時間點略有波動，通常以美元/盎司（USD/oz）為單位報價。若您需要最準確、最新的價格，建議參考以下來源：

| 資料來源 | 連結 |
|----------|------|
| Bloomberg 金價行情 | https://www.bloomberg.com/quote/GC=COM |
| Kitco 黃金價格 | https://www.kitco.com/ |
| Investing.com 黃金即時報價 | https://www.investing.com/commodities/gold |

如果您想知道大致範圍，2024 年 7 月 9 日左右的黃金價格大約在 **$2,200–$2,300 USD/oz**（視市場波動而定）。請以實際交易平台或金融新聞網站的即時報價為準。
message.reasoning: User asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" They want today's gold price in US. We need to provide current gold price. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can provide typical gold price or mention that it's around $X per ounce. But we should be careful. We can say we don't have real-time data. Provide approximate. Also maybe ask for currency. Provide typical price.
